Strategy: Use the sweet band only when at least six bins are open, rewarding leftovers between thirty-five and fifty-five; with fewer bins, fall back to Best Fit. Many open bins mean more choice, so the band matters more. It may help by applying the band only where it can choose, but may fail if six bins are rarely open.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 6 and r - item >= 35 and r - item <= 55 else 0) for r in bins]
```
